dropped.why: only 2 independent sources (Westfield + the Fuller/kslekou Chinese-template group); Woodstock lists only P, dc, k, s
typical values for a family (dk 5.7, dc 7.5 for M3) that contradict the standard-style tables of the other three; excluded

checks: k_max grows with d and k_max < d for M4..M10 (low button head)
P, dc_max, k_max, s strictly increase over M3..M10
no disagreement among the 3 independent groups on any kept cell; only conflict is Woodstock M12 dc 24.0 (typo, row dropped)
shape_hint: Low domed (button) head with a hexagon socket in the centre and a thin flat flange/collar disc at the base that is wider than the dome; unthreaded shank is equal to the thread diameter and the thread runs along the shank to the tip. Head height k is measured from the underside of the collar to the top of the dome.

role_map.k_max: head height max (collar underside to top of dome)

notes: ISO 7380-2 is the collar version of ISO 7380-1; the dome diameter dk is smaller than in ISO 7380-1 (e.g. M5 8.8 vs 9.5) so do not take dk/dc from ISO 7380-1 tables (they are different standards). Sizes M3-M10 only; M12, M16 exist in the standard (Fuller/Westfield) but could not be confirmed by 3 independent pages. Dome diameter dk, collar thickness h and socket depth t are known from 2 independent sources only and were withheld. Property class 10.9 (also A2 stainless).

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched Fuller, kslekou, Westfield, Woodstock live and parsed tables (kslekou label and value tables are separate, aligned by order). 6 rows x 4 cols (24 cells, plus M12/M16 looked at): all 24 equal in Fuller, kslekou, Westfield and Woodstock; no dissent for M3-M10. Headers read: Fuller/kslekou 'dc max', 'k max', 's nominal', 'P'; Westfield 'dc max','k max','s nom','p'. Physical: dc/d 2.19-2.36, k_max<d, all four columns strictly increasing.
problems: Exactly 3 clusters for every cell (Fuller+kslekou count as one). Woodstock headers carry no max/min ('Flange diameter', 'Head depth'); the role is fixed only because its numbers equal dc max / k max of the other two - acceptable under numeric equality but the role is not independently read. Woodstock is not a Westfield copy (its M12 dc 24.0 vs 26.0 elsewhere).

Edition risk: sunhyings.com 'typical' table lists dk 5.7..17.5 and dc 7.5,10,12,14,18,22 (different edition / generic values, explicitly 'example dimensions - confirm against your standard edition'). Not counted, but it shows another set of numbers circulates for ISO 7380-2; the 3 clusters here agree with each other.
M12 (dc Woodstock 24.0) and M16 correctly dropped (2 clusters).
P is the generic ISO 261 coarse pitch (also confirmed by many other pages).
